name: Workspace Content Completeness and Card Diagnostics
features: Module-specific six-card collapsed summaries for every embedded workspace
Stable per-card diagnostic IDs and surface markers
Workflow, readiness, handoff, entity and evidence details visible before expansion
Overflow, wrapping and narrow-card resilience improvements
Accessible card group labels without changing scientific engines
scientific_boundary: The workspace summaries expose configured workflow metadata; they do not create experimental evidence or certify scientific validity.
